name: Namida-bashi o Watatte
source:
Shougo lives in the countryside, enjoying his life with his friends and classmates every day. But he has a secret - he can see supernatural things such as monsters or ghosts. He still lives an ordinary life for now, but one day on a summer vacation Shougo meets a girl, which is the turning point of his new restless life.
There are three girls around him and he falls in love with one of them, and this gradually puts him in danger. This is a quite mysterious and hearty story staged in a quiet town.

[From ErogeShop]
